alt: Central Control's Service tab: the Sunday 9:00 service is running, Amazing Grace is on now with 3:40 left and Holy, Holy, Holy next; below, the church's three services and the run order with minutes and roles.
caption: Run the service from one screen: everyone sees what's on now, what's next and how long is left.

alt: The Lighting tab: the stage in 3D with trusses, moving heads, light bars and beams, above the presets
caption: Lighting: your stage in 3D, with every light where it hangs and where it points.

alt: Central Control's Mix tab: this computer is the audio host, the Central Pedal's tracks arrive as channels (Drums, Bass, Keys, Vocals) with meters and faders, and the service is being recorded.
caption: Mix the tracks at the desk and record the whole service with one button.

alt: Central Control's Slides tab: a list of announcement slides (Welcome, Church picnic, Youth retreat, Scripture, Giving), the Church picnic slide in Preview, and the Live screen.
caption: Make announcement slides, check them in Preview, then send them live to the screens.

alt: Central Control's Lyrics tab: the second verse of Amazing Grace in large text with the next lines shown smaller underneath.
caption: The lyrics follow the song by themselves, with the next lines ready underneath.

alt: Central Control's Devices tab: the built-in player window is the track player and online, and the Office computer is kept in sync as the second main admin's computer.
caption: See every device, and keep the second main admin's computer in sync so it can take over.

alt: Central Control's Settings: this computer is named Sound desk and is the main admin, with its pairing PIN and role PIN, plus options for track outputs, the lighting AI model and lyrics from the vocal.
caption: Settings shows this computer's role and the PINs other devices use to pair.

alt: Central Control's In-ears tab: the in-ear code, the list of channels from the Central Pedal and a grid of mixes, with Mix 1 taken by Sarah (keys).
caption: Up to 64 in-ear mixes: each musician picks a mix and sets their own levels.

alt: Central Control's I/O tab in three columns: what comes in from the Central Pedal, this computer as the audio host, and what goes out to screens and lights.
caption: I/O shows what comes in, what this computer does with it, and what goes out.

alt: Central Control's Video tab: Main and Stream switchers with preview and program monitors, and a multiview with two stage cameras and the slides.
caption: Switch cameras for the room screens and the stream, with slides and lyrics on top.

alt: Central Usage's Chord chart: Amazing Grace in G with chords over the lyrics, the current verse highlighted, and section buttons for each verse.
caption: Each musician's chord chart follows the song and highlights where the band is.

alt: Central Usage's Lyrics tab: the second verse of Amazing Grace in large text with the next verse underneath.
caption: Singers see the words as the song moves, with the next lines coming up.

alt: Central Usage's In-ears tab: Mix 1 with a Listen here button and a fader for each channel - Instrument, Click, Drums, Bass, Keys, Vocals.
caption: Every musician sets their own in-ear mix from their own laptop.

alt: Central Usage's Instrument tab with Piano and keys picked: a grid of 136 sounds with E.Piano 1 chosen, layers, and an on-screen keyboard.
caption: Plug in a keyboard or guitar and play it through 136 built-in sounds.

alt: Central Pedal Control's LIVE screen: the setlist of five hymns, Holy, Holy, Holy playing in D at 88 BPM, verse buttons, big Prev, Pause, Next, Vamp and Safe stop buttons, and eight pads.
caption: LIVE shows exactly what the pedal's buttons do during the service.

alt: Central Pedal Control's PAD screen: eight pad channels (Warm Pad, Ambient Clouds and more) with sound, key, crossfade and effect settings, plus texture channels.
caption: Shape the pads: pick a sound, its key, how it fades in, and add effects.

alt: Central Pedal Control's TRACKS screen: Holy, Holy, Holy's waveform with its verses marked, the lyrics for the current section, rehearse and speed controls, and a mixer for Click, Drums, Bass, Keys and Vocals.
caption: Load a song's tracks, mark its sections, and set the click and cues.

alt: Central Pedal Control's INSTRUMENT screen with Piano and keys picked and Church Organ chosen from 136 sounds, with layers and a keyboard.
caption: Set up the instrument sound the pedal plays from a USB keyboard.

alt: Central Pedal Control's CONFIGURE screen: a list of the pedal's buttons, each with what a press does and what a hold does.
caption: Choose what every button, knob and pedal does - a press and a hold.

alt: Central Pedal Control's LEARN screen: each control-board input with a Learn button, and the default wiring diagram.
caption: Wire your own buttons and knobs, then press Learn to find each one.

alt: Central Pedal Control's I/O screen: sending audio to Central Control over Wi-Fi or Ethernet, and the pedal's four audio outputs for tracks, pads, click and the instrument.
caption: Pick where the pedal's audio goes: the desk, the in-ears, or both.

alt: Central Pedal Control's SETTINGS: colour themes such as Studio and Midnight, the colours of sections and pads, saved setups, the audio engine and output routing.
caption: Make the screens your own and save setups you can bring back with one tap.

alt: Central Pedal, LIVE: The whole service on one screen: the setlist, the song with its key, tempo and time left, the sections, the transport, the pads and your instrument.
caption: The whole service on one screen: the setlist, the song with its key, tempo and time left, the sections, the transport, the pads and your instrument.

alt: Central Pedal, Pad editor: The sound, its key and chord, the crossfade and your imported sounds, with the signal chain listed underneath.
caption: The sound, its key and chord, the crossfade and your imported sounds, with the signal chain listed underneath.

alt: Central Services' Schedule for Grace Church: Sunday 9:00 with its four songs and keys, the Sunday band and Tech team, and each person's answer - Yes, No or Not yet - with 8 yes, 1 no and 1 not yet.
caption: Everyone can see the whole schedule: who's serving, in what role, and who has answered.

alt: Central Services on Leah's account: My requests shows two services she's asked to sing at, Sunday 9:00 and Sunday 11:00, each with Accept and Decline buttons and a place for a note.
caption: Volunteers answer with one tap, and can leave a note if they can't make it.

alt: Central Services' Teams screen for Grace Church: a Slots bar showing 14 of 30 in use, the Sunday band and Evening band worship teams, and the Tech team, each person with their role.
caption: Teams shows who serves where, and how many of your church's slots are in use.

alt: Central Pedal, the pedal from the front left: a 3D render on a black studio floor. The black case, the 7-inch touch screen on LIVE, the 5-inch screen, machined black knobs with a gold edge and pointer, brushed silver fader caps and eight metal stomp switches like a guitar pedal's, with a lit label screen beside each control.
caption: The rev E Central Pedal, rendered from its case design.

alt: Central Pedal, from the front: Straight on from the front. The eight footswitches sit along the front edge with their labels above them.
caption: Straight on from the front. The eight footswitches sit along the front edge with their labels above them.

alt: Central Pedal, from above: From above, so you can see the whole layout: knobs and sliders on both sides of the two screens.
caption: From above, so you can see the whole layout: knobs and sliders on both sides of the two screens.

alt: Central Pedal, the two screens: The two screens up close. LIVE on the 7-inch and the stage view on the 5-inch.
caption: The two screens up close. LIVE on the 7-inch and the stage view on the 5-inch.

alt: Central Pedal, from the front right: From the front right.
caption: From the front right.

alt: Central Pedal, the back: The back: power and USB-C, the network port, the six outputs, both instrument inputs and the four USB ports, each with its own label screen.
caption: The back: power and USB-C, the network port, the six outputs, both instrument inputs and the four USB ports, each with its own label screen.

alt: Central Pedal, Pads: Eight pads, Stop, the key, tap tempo, Freeze, Layer and Morph, the two textures and the knobs for volume, tone, reverb, fade and morph.
caption: Eight pads, Stop, the key, tap tempo, Freeze, Layer and Morph, the two textures and the knobs for volume, tone, reverb, fade and morph.

alt: Central Pedal, Tracks: The song's waveform with its sections in their colours, the transport, key and tempo, and a fader for each stem.
caption: The song's waveform with its sections in their colours, the transport, key and tempo, and a fader for each stem.

alt: Central Pedal, Instrument, electric: A guitar board: each pedal with its knobs, in the order the sound goes through them.
caption: A guitar board: each pedal with its knobs, in the order the sound goes through them.

alt: Central Pedal, Instrument, keys: Keys from a USB keyboard. Each layer has its own sound, volume, octave, range and velocity.
caption: Keys from a USB keyboard. Each layer has its own sound, volume, octave, range and velocity.

alt: Central Pedal, Looper: Each loop as a ring. Record in time with the song or free, set the bars and the count-in.
caption: Each loop as a ring. Record in time with the song or free, set the bars and the count-in.

alt: Central Pedal, Mixer: The buses, the master and every stem, with pan, mute, solo and a button to send a stem to its own output.
caption: The buses, the master and every stem, with pan, mute, solo and a button to send a stem to its own output.

alt: Central Pedal, Scenes: Save what's playing right now (the pads, the mix, the instrument) and bring it back later from here or a footswitch.
caption: Save what's playing right now (the pads, the mix, the instrument) and bring it back later from here or a footswitch.

alt: Central Pedal, Compressor: The curve the compressor follows, and how much it's turning the pad down over the last 10 seconds.
caption: The curve the compressor follows, and how much it's turning the pad down over the last 10 seconds.

alt: Central Pedal, Delay: Where each echo lands and how loud it is, worked out from the song's tempo.
caption: Where each echo lands and how loud it is, worked out from the song's tempo.

alt: Central Pedal, Reverb: The reverb's decay after the pre-delay, drawn from the actual reverb the pad uses.
caption: The reverb's decay after the pre-delay, drawn from the actual reverb the pad uses.

alt: Central Pedal, Pad keyboard: Play the pad in any key to hear it there. The pad's saved key doesn't change.
caption: Play the pad in any key to hear it there. The pad's saved key doesn't change.

alt: Central Pedal, Stage view: The section you're in, big, with the next one and the time left underneath.
caption: The section you're in, big, with the next one and the time left underneath.

alt: Central Pedal, Lyrics: The lines for right now, big, and the next lines under them. They follow the song.
caption: The lines for right now, big, and the next lines under them. They follow the song.

alt: Central Pedal, Chord chart: The chart in the song's key. Pick an instrument and it handles capo shapes for you.
caption: The chart in the song's key. Pick an instrument and it handles capo shapes for you.

alt: Central Pedal, Parts: A part for each instrument, written from the chart and what the tracks play.
caption: A part for each instrument, written from the chart and what the tracks play.

alt: Central Pedal, Bass part: Bass notation and tab for the whole song.
caption: Bass notation and tab for the whole song.

alt: Central Pedal, Drum part: A drum chart with the sections marked.
caption: A drum chart with the sections marked.

alt: Central Pedal, Meters: Each stem's level and the instrument in and out, with the CPU load and any dropouts.
caption: Each stem's level and the instrument in and out, with the CPU load and any dropouts.

alt: Central Pedal, Setlist: The open setlist with its songs in order, and the song library beside it to add from.
caption: The open setlist with its songs in order, and the song library beside it to add from.

alt: Central Pedal, Song editor: The song's name, key, tempo, CCLI number, writers, copyright and what happens when it ends.
caption: The song's name, key, tempo, CCLI number, writers, copyright and what happens when it ends.

alt: Central Pedal, Sections: Each section's length in bars, its cue, its pad and its lyrics.
caption: Each section's length in bars, its cue, its pad and its lyrics.

alt: Central Pedal, Tempo grid: The tempo and beat grid the pedal found, which you can adjust.
caption: The tempo and beat grid the pedal found, which you can adjust.

alt: Central Pedal, Flow: The order the sections play in, so you can repeat a chorus or skip an intro.
caption: The order the sections play in, so you can repeat a chorus or skip an intro.

alt: Central Pedal, Add songs: Central Tracks, track packs from a USB stick, your own files, or a Planning Center plan.
caption: Central Tracks, track packs from a USB stick, your own files, or a Planning Center plan.

alt: Central Pedal, Practice mixes: A stereo file of each song for each musician, with their part turned up, saved to a USB stick.
caption: A stereo file of each song for each musician, with their part turned up, saved to a USB stick.

alt: Central Pedal, Stem splitter: Splits a stereo song into stems right on the pedal, once the separation models are installed.
caption: Splits a stereo song into stems right on the pedal, once the separation models are installed.

alt: Central Pedal, First start: The first time it turns on, it asks for the Wi-Fi, a name for the pedal and your church account. Each step can wait until later.
caption: The first time it turns on, it asks for the Wi-Fi, a name for the pedal and your church account. Each step can wait until later.

alt: Central Pedal, Configure: What every footswitch, knob and slider does, what it does when you hold it, and what its label says.
caption: What every footswitch, knob and slider does, what it does when you hold it, and what its label says.

alt: Central Pedal, Learn: Teach the pedal a MIDI button, knob or slider, or a computer key, then give it a job.
caption: Teach the pedal a MIDI button, knob or slider, or a computer key, then give it a job.

alt: Central Pedal, I/O: Every input and output in one place, including audio to Central Control over the network.
caption: Every input and output in one place, including audio to Central Control over the network.

alt: Central Pedal, Screens: Which pages go on the 5-inch, one at a time or two side by side, and how bright each screen is.
caption: Which pages go on the 5-inch, one at a time or two side by side, and how bright each screen is.

alt: Central Pedal, Appearance: Colour presets and every screen colour, if you want your own.
caption: Colour presets and every screen colour, if you want your own.

alt: Central Pedal, Audio and routing: Where the tracks, pads, click, instrument and looper each go, with a test tone for every output.
caption: Where the tracks, pads, click, instrument and looper each go, with a test tone for every output.

alt: Central Pedal, Wi-Fi: Pick a network, join a hidden one or forget one.
caption: Pick a network, join a hidden one or forget one.

alt: Central Pedal, Screens and glasses: Brightness for both screens and the 38 label screens.
caption: Brightness for both screens and the 38 label screens.

alt: Central Pedal, Stream Deck: Plug in an Elgato Stream Deck and give each key a job and a look.
caption: Plug in an Elgato Stream Deck and give each key a job and a look.

alt: Central Pedal, Packages and sounds: The sound plans you have and the libraries that come with them.
caption: The sound plans you have and the libraries that come with them.

alt: Central Pedal, MIDI and tempo: The tempo, following MIDI clock in, and MIDI out for lights and patch changes.
caption: The tempo, following MIDI clock in, and MIDI out for lights and patch changes.

alt: Central Pedal, Service report: After the service: what played, how long, and anything that went wrong.
caption: After the service: what played, how long, and anything that went wrong.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Stage view: The current section, the next one and the time left.
caption: The current section, the next one and the time left.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Lyrics: Big lines for the singers.
caption: Big lines for the singers.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Chord chart: The chart, large enough to read from a step back.
caption: The chart, large enough to read from a step back.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Setlist: The song that's on now and the next one, lit.
caption: The song that's on now and the next one, lit.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, LIVE: The full LIVE page on the second screen.
caption: The full LIVE page on the second screen.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Tracks: The waveform, the sections and the stem faders.
caption: The waveform, the sections and the stem faders.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Pads: The pads and the performance knobs.
caption: The pads and the performance knobs.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Instrument: The board you're playing through.
caption: The board you're playing through.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Looper: The loops and where each one is.
caption: The loops and where each one is.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Mixer: The buses and stems.
caption: The buses and stems.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Meters: Levels, big.
caption: Levels, big.

alt: Central Pedal, 5-inch screen, Parts: A part for one instrument.
caption: A part for one instrument.
